name: Bengali

ancestors.notes: Descent via Magadhi Apabhraṃśa through Middle Indo-Aryan

notes: Standard Colloquial Bengali (West Bengal/Kolkata, Rarhi-based); inherent vowel is /ɔ/ (not /ə/ like Hindi); ‘য’ = [dʑ] word-initially, [j] elsewhere; ‘শ’ and ‘ষ’ both → [ʃ] (two Sanskrit sibilants merged, unlike the Bangladeshi standard's ʃ/s contrast – Khan 2010); dental/retroflex contrast maintained; breathy stops phonemic but weakening in Bangladeshi speech. Word-final inherent vowel deletion (মানুষ 'person' [manuʃ], not *[manuʃɔ] — the word ends in a bare consonant letter with no vowel sign or virama): measured against the wikipron ben_beng_rarh_broad gold (n=6527), the orthographic inherent vowel is realised as nothing in 3430/4444 (77.2%) of word-final bare-consonant positions, and as raised [o] rather than base [ɔ] in most of the remainder (898/1014 retained cases); it is never deleted in single-syllable words, where it is the word's only nucleus (43/43 in the gold, kept as ɔ in every case but one — ভ 'a Bengali letter name' is retained as raised [o] like the polysyllabic retained cases, so the raising condition is not confined to non-monosyllables). This spec ships the deletion via inherent_vowel_final, whose word-final branch is already gated on the word carrying another nucleus, matching the single-syllable exception exactly. Fixing this alone moved the wikipron row from 0.3162 to 0.2395 PER; a fold that also neutralises the residual quality/deletion choice on both sides measures a 0.2274 ceiling, so most of the remaining error is unrelated to the inherent vowel (conjunct/যা-phala decoding is the next largest visible residual, not yet fixed here). The rate is a measured distribution, not a categorical phonological rule; Ferguson & Chowdhury (1960) is the classic description of this deletion (see sources; article not obtained this session, no locator claimed), and Khan (2010) transcribes it throughout the JIPA illustration passage (e.g. আনার /anar/ 'for bringing', not *anarɔ), but the exact deletion RATE by word length is this session's own count against the gold, not a cited figure.

wikipron.citation: Scored as-is (this spec's fixed inherent_vowel_final="") the row is 0.2395 PER. Stripping the final vowel character from BOTH hypothesis and gold whenever the orthographic word ends in a bare consonant letter (neutralising the remaining deletion/raising choice on both sides) measures 0.2274 -- this isolates what is left of the inherent-vowel phenomenon from the conjunct/যা-phala and other residual errors; see the notes field for the underlying counts.
